name: LLaVA-Bench-Wilder
description: LLaVA-Bench-Wilder is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness and generalization of visual-language models on challenging, out-of-distribution image–question pairs. It focuses on open-ended VQA-style tasks where models must reason about visual content and produce free-form answers, measuring performance across diverse and difficult visual scenarios. The benchmark is intended to stress-test LMMs for vision-language understanding beyond standard VQA datasets.
reputation: A community dataset used by researchers studying LMM robustness; modest adoption so far on Hugging Face and in related papers.
